methods.description: Multiply hourly rate by total work hours.
Divide total pay to find the hourly rate or hours.
Multiply normal rate by a stated penalty multiplier.
Add separately calculated pay bands or use equivalent normal hours, forward or reverse.
Determine overtime hours before applying their rate and adding extras.
Convert salary through annual pay using12months52weeks26fortnights.
Multiply per-task pay or divide target pay and round up whole tasks.
Separate piecework/percentage bands and apply rates only to relevant excess.
Percentage of sales, plus any retainer.
Add the stated allowance for each eligible day or shift.
Find the stated percentage of yearly earnings and add it.
Find percentage of eligible normal leave pay, distinguish loading from total, or reverse to normal pay.
Equate the two pay formulas and solve for sales.
